people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: All the souls who came out of Jacob’s body were seventy souls, and Joseph was in Egypt already.
translations.bsb: The descendants of Jacob numbered seventy in all, including Joseph, who was already in Egypt.
translations.kjv: And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls: for Joseph was in Egypt
translations.asv: And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls: and Joseph was in Egypt already.
